test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Accomodate**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is '**Accommodate**'.
 
• The word means to provide lodging or to make someone feel comfortable. (आवास प्रदान करना या किसी को आरामदायक महसूस कराना)
 
 
• **For example**: *The hotel can accommodate up to 200 guests.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other words are correctly spelt. Let us look at the meaning of those words.
 
 
• **Affection**: A feeling of liking or love towards someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के प्रति पसंद या प्रेम की भावना)
 
• **Appearance**: The way someone or something looks. (जिस तरह से कोई व्यक्ति या वस्तु दिखती है)
 
• **Accompanied**: To go somewhere with someone. (किसी के साथ कहीं जाना है)
